title: Hearthlight 03: Cozy Pet Care Sound Effects
shortText: 126 cozy pet SFX: 8 pets, each greet, ask, eat, drink, petted, play, groom, sleep loop, plus toys and home. WAV + OGG.
html:
Every pet from greeting to sleep

126 cozy pet sound effects: 8 pets, and every one ships the same 8 stage care chain, from the moment it greets the player to the moment it falls asleep, each pet its own way.

Licence, up front

Royalty free. Commercial use. No attribution required. Use it in as many games as you like, on any platform. The one thing you may not do is resell or redistribute the sounds themselves as a sound pack. The plain language terms ship as LICENSE.txt, with a copy and paste credit line for anyone who wants one. Everything is synthesised from code, so there is no upstream sample licence behind it.

Hear it first

There is a free demo on this page: 35 sounds copied unaltered from the paid files. The cat and the small dog complete, every stage and every take, the greet of the other 6 pets, the whole purr ladder (five levels of contentment), a cafe with cats loop, kibble into a bowl, a squeaky toy, a collar bell, a pet settling into its bed and a happiness cue.

One chain, every pet

A pet game repeats one loop all day: the pet comes to say hello, asks for something, is fed, is petted, plays and falls asleep. Every pet here ships that loop under the same names:

  • greet: the pet arrives on its own feet (or wings) and says a small hello
  • ask: two takes of a short stylised call, for food, a door or attention
  • eat and drink: from its own bowl, at its own pace, lapping, from a bottle or with a beak
  • petted: a hand along the fur and the pet's own contentment, a purr, a tail, a chirr
  • play: the pet's own game, a jingle ball, a squeaky toy, a wheel, a toy bell
  • groom: licking, a full body shake, a preen or a scratch
  • sleep: a seamless breathing loop for as long as it sleeps

So you wire a pet once and only its name changes: cat_eat, parrot_eat, hedgehog_eat. Checked from the shipped files, not promised: all 8 pets carry exactly this chain, the 224 pairs of stages inside each pet all differ, and across the whole grid the pet changes the sound and so does the stage (448 pairs, 0 alike).

Eight voices, not one at eight pitches

The asks are a cast: a mew, a kitten's mew, a yip, a deep boof, a rabbit's soft grunt and thump, a ferret's dooks, a parrot's whistle and a hedgehog's snuffle. Measured from the shipped files, all 28 pairs of voices differ in brightness or in length, so no pet is another one transposed.

An affection meter you can hear

A purr at five levels of contentment, from a closed hum to a full open rumble, each brighter than the last, and a dog's tail thumping the floor one to five times. Wire them to your pet's happiness value and step up the ladder as it rises. Measured from the shipped files: 8 steps, each purr step at least 8% brighter and each tail step at least 12% longer, failing steps: 0.

The pets

  • Cat: soft pads across the floor, a curious mew, a purr when petted, a rough tongue at grooming time.
  • Kitten: tiny quick steps, a high little mew, a fast light purr and a jingle ball batted across the room.
  • Small dog: claws ticking on the floor, a bright yip, a squeaky toy and a full body shake.
  • Big dog: heavy paws, a deep boof, loud lapping, a tail that thumps the floor and a slow snore.
  • Rabbit: soft hops and a warning thump, busy nibbling, a water bottle, a quiet tooth purr when content.
  • Ferret: skittering paws, happy dooking, a war dance that bumps into the furniture, a quick scratch.
  • Parrot: a flutter onto the perch, a bright whistle, seeds cracked one by one, a toy bell and a preen through the feathers.
  • Hedgehog: a tiny patter, busy snuffling, quills settling when stroked, a night run on the wheel and little snore puffs.

Around the pets

  • 10 food and water sounds: kibble into a metal bowl and a ceramic one, a food tin opening, wet food from a spoon, a treat jar opened and shaken, a water bowl filling, a seed cup and a handful of hay.
  • 8 toy sounds: a squeaky toy, a bouncing ball, a feather wand, a crinkle ball and a rattling toy mouse.
  • 15 home and grooming sounds: a scratching post, a pet bed, a pet door flap, a collar bell, a leash clip, a brush, a bath, a towel, a litter scoop and a hutch door opening and closing.
  • 5 ambience loops: pets asleep by the fire, a cafe with cats, the back yard, a pet shop and rain on the window with a purr.
  • 6 soft interface sounds: adopting a pet, naming it, happiness up and down, an empty bowl hint and a pick.

Fit

  • WAV and OGG for every file, 16 bit, 44.1 kHz, mono, with a naming manifest listing every file by pet and stage.
  • 13 seamless loops of 3.6 to 6.6 seconds with loop points in both formats, and none on a one shot.
  • 16 variation sets whose takes differ in length and in brightness, so the tenth time a pet asks for food is not the first one again.
  • One loudness band: the inner 80 percent of the pack sits inside 1.21 dB, so a big dog lapping and a menu tick share a mix.
  • Import notes for Unity, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker, RPG Maker and the web, and pack_proof.json with a sha256 and a measurement for every file: 1160 checks, 0 failed.

Already own the farm or the kitchen?

Every file here was measured against every file in Hearthlight and Hearthlight 02 (29358 pairs, on spectral shape and on envelope, each tolerant of a transposition): 29358 of 29358 are separate sounds. The proof ships in the download as cross_pack_proof.json. The line shares a voice; it does not share files.

Honest limits

These are synthesised, stylised sounds designed for games, not field recordings. The pet calls are short and shaped in code from a simple voice model: a cozy game's pets, not recordings of real animals. The figures above are signal measurements, not a claim that anything sounds good; that is what the free demo is for. No farm animals, crops or kitchen dishes (those live in the farm and kitchen packs) and nothing musical: a happiness cue is a soft sparkle, never a jingle.

AI disclosure, stated truthfully: the code that generates these sounds was written with AI assistance. The sounds themselves are self contained procedural synthesis by Core Systems Asset Factory, with no generative audio model at any point. The cover art and store graphics are made by AI written code from the pack's own waveforms.

More from the same studio

  • Hearthlight, the farm: eight crops from the seed to the basket, on the same kind of chain.
  • Hearthlight 02, the kitchen: eight dishes from the pantry to the plate.
  • Blip 04, a village cast of dialogue voices for the people who own these pets.
